description: Outburst flood simulations of various dam failure scenarios from Tsho Rolpa glacial lake, Nepal, 2020 is a dataset listed in UK national open data portal, an open data portal, published or maintained by Environmental Information Data Centre. This dataset contains maximum water depth and maximum water velocity for 12 different Glacial Lake outburst floods (GLOFs) scenarios of the Tsho Rolpa Lake, Nepal. Also included is the water depth of dam breach flow and discharge of dam breach flow under each scenario. The GLOFs scenarios were created using a simple dam breach model. Coverage: United Kingdom. The portal files it under the publisher Environmental Information Data Centre. Its tags are Glacial lake outburst floods, Hydrodynamic flood modelling. It offers 2 resource(s) in ZIP. The portal shows 2026-09-18 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support flood defence and reservoir studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ckan-uk-portal.
